_comment: Five-family judge panel. Diversity is the point: five seats from five different labs disagree in different directions, which is the only cheap signal that a score is real rather than one model's taste. Verify IDs with `npm run verify:panel` before a run — OpenRouter slugs change.
_notes: gemini seat deliberately sits on the direct API, not OpenRouter — if OpenRouter has an outage the panel still reaches quorum.
visualPanel excludes text-only seats: DeepSeek and Kimi seats are omitted there because a blind seat cannot score visual evidence.
gemini leads visualPanel because it is the only adapter with native video understanding; the others receive sampled keyframes.
panelQuorum.judge=3 of 5 means two dead seats still produce a verdict, three does not.
maxJudgeSpread=25 blocks shipping when the panel is genuinely split rather than averaging the disagreement away.
